blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and over. Do not give it to children younger than the stated age.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; keep it away from small children so they do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking.
• This product has pointed or sharp parts; take care when handling and storing it. It may cause unexpected injuries.
• This product uses electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care.
• Do not use this product near the ear. Accidental use near the ear may damage hearing.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED light. It may cause nausea or other ill effects.
• If you use batteries incorrectly they may overheat, burst, or leak. Observe the following precautions.
• Never use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert the batteries with correct +/− polarity.
• After playing, always turn off the switch and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or put the batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If it gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of the product, follow your local municipality's disposal instructions.
